data.body: CORRECTION to my GAP 5 survey comment on this ticket. It stated that the stale-premise prose lives in "test_gate_dispatch_seam.py:4 and plan_review_recovery.py:8". The plan_review_recovery.py:8 half is WRONG and was repeated from there into three hardening tickets before d8ef's plan review caught it. That docstring says the three finalize_verdict call sites "live in THIS CLUSTER" and there are exactly three in that file (:223, :297, :336) — it is ACCURATE. Only test_gate_dispatch_seam.py carries a false present-tense claim, and specifically its ASSERTION MESSAGE, which asserts on gate_dispatch.py while describing "its three finalize_verdict call sites" (gate_dispatch holds zero). Verified in source. The survey's other findings stand.
